name: DECISION NEEDED (D1 + D2b) — who owns the QA gate fail-open fix and the Node runtime / node suite declaration · decide by 2026-11-19
description:
Escalation card written by the ProjectManager on 2026-11-18 (shift 2). Status `onhold` = waiting for a human; no AI agent can close this card. Two decisions are blocking the M1 verification increment, and one of them has a deadline of TOMORROW (2026-11-19).

## Why this is on the board
The IT team board has 5 owned cards (M1.1–M1.5). Two of them cannot be closed from inside this repository, and I proved it rather than guessed it:
- `project_locate("min_coverage")` → 0 evidence in the code.
- `search_codx(query="qa", modules=[project, workspaces, teams])` → no matches in 235 KB of project data.
So the rule that makes the QA gate run a single `pytest` suite (with a 70.0 coverage threshold) lives at platform level, not in `client/`.

## D1 — Who fixes the fail-open QA gate?
`qa_review_changes` returns `allow` when the path filter matches nothing, so an unverified change can be called done. Tracking card: `94d15daf` (owner software_developer, wake 2026-11-20 09:00Z).
- (a) Escalate to the platform repo, keep `94d15daf` as the tracking card — RECOMMENDED. Cost: 0 extra days.
- (b) Fix it from this repo (+1–2 days, cross-repo change with no test coverage).
- (c) Accept the risk and require manual evidence on every card (permanent overhead).
Decide by 2026-11-20.

## D2b — Who puts Node in the QA environment and declares the `node` suite?
Measured, not assumed: `docker exec codx-junior-api node --version` (and codx-junior-client, cj-buildcheck, cj-imgtest) → "node: executable file not found in $PATH". `apt-get` is denied for the non-root agent (dpkg lock), so no agent here can install it. Tracking card: `91411767` (owner devops, wake 2026-11-19 09:30Z).
- (a) Platform ships Node into the image that executes `qa_run_tests` and declares a `node` suite — RECOMMENDED. Cost: image growth + one rebuild, ~half a day of platform time.
- (b) Point the policy at an external Node (hours now, breaks on any host change).
- (c) No client tests (leaves the 5 existing `tests/*.test.mjs` files decorative).
**Decide by 2026-11-19 (tomorrow). This is the single gate on Friday's demo.**

## Consequence if D2b is not answered by 2026-11-19 17:00Z
`a0f362ed` goes `onhold` with the blocker commented (it must NOT retry a non-root install), and the demo moves from Friday 2026-11-20 to **Monday 2026-11-23**. That slip is already written on `91411767` and on this card; it will be reported as a decision, not as news.

## What is NOT blocked by these decisions
The in-repo half of M1.1 — `"test": "node --test tests/"` in `client/package.json` — is delivered by devops independently, and `fcf65219` (the EffortsSettings delete bug, customer-visible) ships tomorrow regardless.

## When this card is answered
Reply with the chosen option for D1 and D2b, then close it. `wake_at` 2026-11-19T17:00Z wakes me to check the answer and to make the GO/NO-GO call for the demo.

messages.content:
Two decisions are blocking the M1 verification increment and one has a deadline of tomorrow (2026-11-19). Both are platform-level: I proved the QA policy is not declared in this repository (`project_locate("min_coverage")` → 0 evidence; `search_codx` on project data → no matches), and no agent here can install Node (non-root, dpkg lock denied).

- **D1:** who fixes the fail-open `qa_review_changes` (returns `allow` on an empty path filter)? Recommended: escalate to the platform repo, keep `94d15daf` as tracking card. Decide by 2026-11-20.
- **D2b:** who ships Node into the image that runs `qa_run_tests` and declares a `node` suite? Recommended: (a) platform does both. Decide by **2026-11-19** — it is the single gate on Friday's demo.

If D2b is unanswered by 2026-11-19 17:00Z: `a0f362ed` goes `onhold` and the demo moves to 2026-11-23. Nothing else in the increment is blocked.

## PM note (shift 4, 2026-11-18) — no answer received; conservative defaults applied

No human answered inside this shift (expected — the shift runs unattended). Per the standing orders I do not stall on an open question, so I am recording the **default** I will act on if no answer arrives before **2026-11-19 17:00Z**. Answering the card before then still overrides it.

**D1 — the 5 platform cards (`94d15daf`, `8a554fa4`, `b19676fe`, `3a86fba9`, `79a1336d`).**
- **Default taken: option (b), keep them on the IT team board, tagged `platform`, out of increment M1.** Rationale: moving boards is the only irreversible action available to me and I will not do it without a human. Their `wake_at` values (11-20 / 11-21 / 11-23) already keep them out of the M1 critical path, so keeping them costs nothing this week.
- **What it costs:** the board stays noisy (5 of 10 cards are not this application's work) and one agent per card per wake will burn budget on gates it cannot change from inside `client/`.
- If option (a) is chosen later, the move is one `update_task` per card — no work is lost either way.

**D2b — who owns the Node runtime card `91411767` / the node suite declaration.**
- **Default taken: devops stays the owner**, because the runtime is a container/image property and no client-side change can fix it. I am not reassigning it to software_developer: previous shifts **measured** `node --version` → `node: executable file not found in $PATH` in `codx-junior-api`, `codx-junior-client`, `cj-buildcheck` and `cj-imgtest`. It is not a code problem.
- **Consequence for the demo: see D3 below.** If `node --version` has not changed by the 11-19 12:00Z checkpoint, the demo moves to **Monday 11-19… → Monday 11-23 11:00** and cannot be moved back by will: without a Node binary there is no executed suite and therefore nothing to show beyond the 9 written cases.

**D3 — demo slot.** Decided at the 11-19 12:00Z checkpoint on Node evidence only (card `ed8d3ebb`). Friday 16:00 is still the intent; the checkpoint is the switch.

**D4 — commit the +123/-0 tree.** Still "not before M1b". Evidence gathered this shift: `src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue` is genuinely in the pending diff (+123/-0) and carries the single HIGH finding at line 183. Committing first would land a HIGH on the branch; the fix is a confirmed 3-line deletion, so this ordering costs minutes.

**What a human must decide, in one line each, if they disagree with any default:** (1) move the platform cards → say "D1a"; (2) someone else owns Node → name them; (3) demo Monday → say "D3 Monday".

PM shift 5 (2026-11-18T16:33Z) — one NEW decision item for management, added after measuring the working tree. It changes what "M1 committable" means.

D5 — How is the efforts increment committed, given that the tree holds 65 changed files (+2219/-221) across four unrelated in-flight features?
- Measured today: besides efforts, the tree carries browsers/volume mappings (~1200 lines, 8 new files), a chat find bar (+315), a voice module, and the recurrence UI in `TaskSettings.vue` (+123). `package.json` also carries an unowned MAJOR bump `vue3-virtual-scroller ^0.2.3 -> ^2.0.3`.
- Option A (recommended): commit by explicit pathspec — `src/api/modules/efforts.js`, `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue`, `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`, plus only the `"test"` hunk of `package.json`. The increment stays small, reviewable, demoable and revertable. The rest stays dirty. Cost: ~10 min. Card created: `0bc8b144`, wakes 2026-11-19T13:00Z.
- Option B: one commit for the whole tree. Cheapest to execute, but no increment can then be demoed or reverted alone — it contradicts the delivery rule, so I recommend against it.
- Option C: hold the commit until the recurrence feature is finished. Rejected: it puts an unrelated feature on the critical path of a 4-line fix.
- Decide by: 2026-11-19T12:00Z. Default if silent: Option A (it is already written as a task).

Also correcting the record on this card: the reason the HIGH comment blocks the commit is NOT that `TaskSettings.vue` is part of the efforts increment — it is not (I verified the +123 lines are the recurrence UI). It blocks because the CISO gate evaluates `scope=all` and is not diff-aware (`79a1336d`). Consequence: deleting the 3 comment lines unblocks BOTH increments at once, and this is why `675c4695` stays on the critical path even though its file is out of the efforts commit.

**New fact for D3 — this changes what you must decide, and it is why the demo dates moved.** (PM shift 8, 14:30Z)

D3 (which slice to commit) is no longer a scoping question. At 14:28Z the card `0bc8b144` was processed with the node precondition withdrawn, and the answer was one line:

> `commit not executable: no shell/exec tool and no HEAD-write tool in this runtime`

So **no AI agent in this deployment can create a commit**, whatever we choose. Three shifts were spent waiting for a capability that does not exist. Consequences, all dated:

| # | Human action | Blocks | Deadline |
|---|---|---|---|
| **D3'** | Run 4 git commands (block is on `0bc8b144`), pathspec-only | the entire M1 increment | **2026-11-20T12:00Z** (before the 16:00Z go/no-go) |
| **D2b** | Node in the image that runs `qa_run_tests` | client tests **and** the demo (rebuild) | **2026-11-19T17:00Z** — today |
| **D1** | Who owns the QA fail-open fix | trust in every `allow` verdict | 2026-11-20 |

**Slips already applied, not announced silently:** M1 demo run `2cd6e1f6` → **Mon 2026-11-23T15:00Z** (it cannot run without a commit and a rebuild), with a pull-forward to Fri 11-20T18:00Z if D3' and D2b land by 11-20T12:00Z. Commit verification `f48294e8` stays 11-20T15:00Z and now returns **NOT RUN** rather than FAIL when nothing was committed.

**Recommendation unchanged:** D2b → (a) platform ships Node; D3' → do it yourself, tonight, 2 minutes; D1 → (a) escalate to the platform repo. What is *not* blocked: `fcf65219` (the customer-visible delete bug) is written and needs only the commit to become demoable — the code is already in the tree.
